title: Bell House: Pool, Ocean View, Office, Sun Room

images.caption: Office with desk, chair and monitors

description: The Bell House is an iconic Rincón property, known for its unique Spanish style and the famous “Bell of the Puntas neighborhood.” This chic 3BR/2.5BA beach cottage offers a pool, screened-in porch, spacious outdoor areas, and an upper wraparound balcony with ocean and sunset views. Just a 10-minute walk to Sandy Beach, it’s perfect for families and friends who want comfort, style, and close proximity to all that Rincón offers. Plenty of parking available.The spaceThe Bell House is a chic Spanish-style home that offers both privacy and comfort, with a spacious kitchen and living area perfect for gathering with family and friends. Entry is at street level, leading down a staircase to the main living space and pool terrace below.A screened sunroom creates a breezy indoor-outdoor retreat, complete with a hammock—perfect for an afternoon nap or relaxing with a book. Just off the sunroom is a dedicated office equipped with a desk, chair, and monitor, plus a daybed for a quick recharge between tasks.Workout equipment is available for your use, including yoga mats and blocks, free weights, a jump rope, and more—perfect for staying active during your stay.The pool deck is designed for outdoor living, featuring a dining table, comfortable seating area, large adjustable umbrella, sun loungers, and a propane Weber grill—ideal for enjoying meals and sunsets.All three bedrooms, as well as the main living room, are equipped with air conditioning, while the screened terrace includes ceiling fans for additional comfort.The primary suite features its own private entrance for added seclusion, along with direct access to the pool deck. **Bedroom Layout:*** **Primary Suite:** King bed, ensuite bathroom, A/C, private entrance, and direct pool access* **Bedroom 2:** King bed, A/C, shared full bathroom* **Bedroom 3:** Two twin beds, A/C, shared full bathroomThe kitchen is fully stocked with everything you need, including a gas stove, dishwasher, microwave, fridge/freezer, rice maker, air fryer, toaster, blender, and more.For added peace of mind, the home is equipped with a 700-gallon backup water cistern and a new Generac propane generator to help mitigate Puerto Rico’s occasional power or water outages. We kindly ask guests to be mindful of utility usage during their stay.Guest accessGuests can access the entire property except for one room off the back deck, which is locked for the owners' use only. There's plenty of parking.Other things to noteWe reserve the right to cancel or limit bookings based on the number of nights during holiday weeks/weekends (3–7 nights). Exceptions may apply.We are located on the western point of Puerto Rico, close to several airports:• Aguadilla (BQN) – 30 minutes away, with daily flights from JFK, Fort Lauderdale, Orlando (JetBlue), and Newark (United).• Mayagüez (MAZ) – 25 minutes away, with 6 daily Cape Air flights from San Juan—an excellent way to avoid the long drive from SJU.• San Juan (SJU) – 2.5 hours away, with daily flights on all major airlines.• Ponce (PSE) – 1.5 hours away, with JetBlue service.Rental car options: Avis, Hertz, Budget, Enterprise, Target, and Charlie’s Car Rental.Rideshares: Uber is not available in Rincón, and taxis are limited—advance scheduling is required. Taxi and private car services can be arranged for airport transfers.The home features a Generac propane generator for power outages and a 700-gallon water cistern with pump for water outages. Power and water interruptions do occur in Puerto Rico, so we kindly ask guests to use utilities mindfully—please do not waste water or electricity, and always turn off A/C units when not in the room.

title: Casa Rosado Rincon Wave Suite 2BR with 2 Pools
description: Casa Rosado Rincon Boutique Hotel Wave Suite is A Modern Two Bedroom that offers a King & Full Size Beds, Full Kitchen, Cooking Essentials, Livingroom, AC, WIFI, BBQ Grill, Two Pools, Outdoor Shower, Outdoor Dinning Area, Sun Longe Chairs, Beach Essentials & Solar Panels for peace of mind. Just 5 minutes to the Town with Restaurants, Bars and Best Surfing Beaches in Puerto Rico. Perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape while enjoying the vibrant culture and natural beauty of the island.The spaceNestled is the heart of Rincon, where breathtaking mountains and valley views awaits you. This exquisite property is perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape while enjoying the vibrant culture and natural beauty of the island. Relax by our private beautiful Kio Pond and Garden while being greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere with two beautiful pools. Just five minutes from Pueblo de Rincon & All Surfing Beaches. This property features four units, The Rayo Suite, Surfer Suite, Gallo Suite & Wave Suite. Perfect for Family Reunions, Wedding & Birthdays. Property is ideal for Couples & Adults Only. All common areas are shared with all units and guest. It may not be suitable for children under 14 years of age.Guest accessGuests are welcomed to enjoy the entire property with both Pools, Lounge Chairs, BBQ Grills, & beautiful Kio Fish Pond area. Each Units does offer their own private area for your access only. For Security purposes cameras are in the pool and parking areas. Please do not access unauthorized areas marked. NO OUTSIDE GUEST.Other things to noteThis property is not suitable for children under 14. (Preferably) for Adults Only. Puerto Rico has a power grid issue and power outage are common, but we are equipped with Solar Panels with Tesla batteries, so you can enjoy your vacation without the power issues. PLEASE note that during power grid outage less power has to be consumed so please leaving only one AC on at 75 degrees & do not use hot water to preserve power during the outage. Washer & Dryer are available free to guest with a reservation of 4 or More Days or applied $20 fee per stay which includes detergent for guests that are staying less than 4 daysWe are situated at the westernmost point of the island. We are 2.5 hours from the San Juan Airport (SJU), 30 minutes from both Aguadilla Airport (BQN) & Mayaguez Airport (MAZ), and 1.5 hours from Ponce Airport (PSE) airport. To avoid the drive from San Juan, there is a Cape Air flight that goes directly multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ Scooter rental available on site. Contact us directly as our guests get 20% off. This is the best way to enjoy Thursday Night Art Feast with zero parking issues or see our beautiful sunsets at the Light House.

title: Villa Isabella - Oceanfront - 10 guests

You don't need to take the car to get there.You could book the whole Villa 3, Villa Isabella together with Villa Maria (lower level) to make it a nine-bedroom luxury Villa for 18 guests.Sunset Paradise Villas counts on eight villas, that can be booked separately or in combination, fitting maximum 50 guests. title: Casa Kahuna-Modern/Luxury with OCEAN VIEWS/POOL
description: Located off Rincón’s famed Route 413, the “Road to Happiness,” Kahuna is a modern, spacious home ideal for families and friends. Enjoy sweeping valley and Caribbean Sea views, wall-to-wall glass, and expansive terraces designed by cutting-edge New York architects. Features include 4BR/3.5BA, full kitchen, A/C in bedrooms, WiFi, Smart TVs, washer/dryer, pool, beach gear, workout equipment, plus backup power and water.The spaceThis villa features a private pool, ocean views, a fully equipped outdoor grill, and a dedicated fitness studio. Enjoy premium sound with the Sonos system. The home includes two reliable backup power sources—solar with Tesla batteries and a generator for essential circuits (lights, fans, refrigerator). A 700-gallon cistern provides backup water. With 4 bedrooms and 3.5 baths, the property sleeps a maximum of 8 guests.Guest accessGuests have full access to the house. Please stay out of the locked closet marked OWNERS and the gated cage in the garage that has surfboards and other equipment that is not for renters' use.Other things to noteBe sure to visit the Art Walk on Thursday nights in the Rincon Plaza (local artists, restaurants, Rincon Beer co) and the Sunday morning for the Farmers Market in Aguada (organic local vegetables, fruits, honey, etc). The Rincon Light House has some amazing views and beautiful sunsets. If you have time to explore a little, take a trip to the beautiful cliffs of Cabo Rojo light house. They are spectacular & visit the San Sebastian waterfalls.We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyDue to severe allergies, the owners cannot allow any animals in the house, even service animals. Please respect this rule. There are exterior security cameras at the entry access points on the property.We are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan there is a Cape Air flight that goes direct multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

description: Open the door to this 2BR penthouse with panoramic coastal views, & get transported to your own Rincón paradise. Open both sets of double doors to the deck, & breathe in the salt air. Step out on the secluded 50 ft balcony to sip your morning coffee, & count the iguanas sunbathing in the nearby trees.Grab the beach chairs provided & walk downhill to a pristine hidden beach with calm, clear water. You’ll probably be the only ones there. Let the sea carry your cares away with the tide!The spaceDrive into the gated driveway and open the doors to an idyllic Rincón getaway! No stairs or elevator; you enter right into the penthouse suite. You'll be immediately captivated by the breathtaking view!Step into the thoughtfully curated living area, the heart of this condo, which opens up to the expansive balcony, a seamless extension of the living space that frames the ocean with a spectacular vista!. Five floor-to- ceiling glass doors flood the interior with natural light and warm ocean breezes. The comfortable seating is perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply losing yourself in the views. A smart TV offers entertainment with most major streaming services. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, this gated oceanfront retreat with parking delivers an unforgettable island experience for up to four quests.KitchenThe kitchen is well appointed with everything you need to prepare meals. Ample counter space and modern appliances make cooking with a view a joy rather than a chore. Dine at the kitchen counter with seating for four, or al fresco on the deck dining table. Exceptional restaurants are a mere minutes walk away- Pa'l 24 Steakhouse, Kaplash, and Fiebre are all at the top of our hill, and the nearby Rincon Beach Resort, just a 15 minute walk along the shore, offers casual beachside dining and drinks. BedroomsThis penthouse comfortably sleeps four guests in two separate bedrooms, each with a queen sized bed, air conditioning, and a ceiling fan.Outdoor spaceThe star of this duplex, the balcony has lots of comfortable seating overlooking the sparkling Caribbean Sea. Stretch out in the hammock and stargaze while listening to the waves. Sip wine on the cozy couch nestled in a covered nook Do some yoga in complete privacy, or dine al fresco with a view.Grab the beach chairs, towels, and cooler provided & hike a short adventurous path down to a hidden beach. Bask in the Caribbean sun, or find a shaded spot to enjoy the calm water, and watch the sunset. On weekends, a vibrant karaoke bar adds an extra touch of island nightlife energy to the area. AmenitiesThe private condo includes high speed wifi, air conditioning and ceiling fans in both bedrooms and living room, washing machine and dryer, parking in the secure gated driveway, and complimentary essentials.Guest accessThe entire space is yours... no sharing, completely yours and private.Other things to noteIsland living has it's own rhythm. Occasional power outages may occur, but our local authorities work diligently to restore services quickly. If this occurs, it's just another good excuse to relax on the beach, or hit the local restaurants.We have power backup systems to charge your phones & cook a meal.

title: Hacienda Leo 2 Bedroom Villa with Pool
description: Hacienda Leo is a 2 Bedroom Villa with 1 Bath and is situated in a quiet dead end road with beautiful views of the Ocean and Valley. Only a few minutes away from Sandy beaches and restaurants as well as 8 minutes to Rincon and less than that to grocery stores, a pharmacy and a bakery. Enjoy jumping in our spacious pool and dine outdoors on our large covered terrace. 2 Queen beds available.The spaceWe provide:- We provide the basic supplies like trash bags and toilet paper to get you started but after that please feel free to drive a minute down the road to Colmado Rodriguez, a small store, for your additional needs. -Modern AC units in both bedrooms- Comfortable memory foam mattresses - Fresh bath towels for each guest - Swimming pool with water fountain and beautiful illumination at night- A large dining table on our covered terrace - can also be moved inside if so desired) - TV (Connect to your Netflix or Hulu account to enjoy movies)- Internet- A fully equipped kitchen with gas stove and oven. - Microwave- Coffee maker- Quality blender for smoothies and mixed drinks- Bluetooth speakerWhat we do not provide at this time:- Beach towels, beach chairs, umbrellas etc- Cable Television- Entertainment subscriptions such as Netflix, Hulu, Apple TV etc. - Access to a washer and dryerIMPORTANT:Puerto Rico can occasionally experience power and water outages. They are beyond our control. We provide a backup generator that can run from 6 pm to 7 am and will need to be turned off during the day. We also provide backup water (cool only-not heated) - we have a 400 gallon cistern that gravity feeds the house. The pressure will be significantly lower but you will have water in the house. Please, only book if you are willing to accept the above stated for the rare power and water outages that we are experiencing. ———- absolutely no parties allowed. - if bodily fluids are found on any of the furniture or on the beds etc. then an extra $500-$1000 charge may be added for additional cleaning. - if you show up with more than the allowed guests then your reservation may be canceled immediately/on arrival
